title.vi: Khởi tạo trọng số: Xavier, He và gradient biến mất
title.en: Weight initialisation: Xavier, He and vanishing gradients

summary.vi: phương sai qua các tầng, Xavier cho tanh, He cho ReLU, vì sao khởi tạo 0 hỏng
summary.en: variance across layers, Xavier for tanh, He for ReLU, why zero init fails

files.name: main.py
files.code:
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x = rng.normal(size=(1000, 256))

def forward_std(init, act, depth=10, width=256):
    a = x
    for _ in range(depth):
        W = init(width, width)
        a = act(a @ W)
    return float(a.std())

small = lambda n_in, n_out: rng.normal(0, 0.01, (n_in, n_out))              # quá nhỏ -> tín hiệu tắt dần
xavier = lambda n_in, n_out: rng.normal(0, np.sqrt(1 / n_in), (n_in, n_out))  # Var = 1/n_in
he = lambda n_in, n_out: rng.normal(0, np.sqrt(2 / n_in), (n_in, n_out))      # Var = 2/n_in
relu = lambda z: np.maximum(0, z)

print("tanh  + nhỏ  :", round(forward_std(small, np.tanh), 6))
print("tanh  + Xavier:", round(forward_std(xavier, np.tanh), 3))
print("ReLU  + Xavier:", round(forward_std(xavier, relu), 3))
print("ReLU  + He    :", round(forward_std(he, relu), 3))

prompt.vi: Dùng rng = default_rng(0), x ~ N(0,1) kích thước (1000, 256), 10 tầng 256→256 với ReLU. Khởi tạo He (std = √(2/n_in)). In True nếu độ lệch chuẩn kích hoạt cuối nằm trong khoảng (0.5, 3), ngược lại False.
prompt.en: Use rng = default_rng(0), x ~ N(0,1) of shape (1000, 256), 10 layers 256→256 with ReLU. Initialise with He (std = √(2/n_in)). Print True if the final activation std lies in (0.5, 3), else False.

solution.name: main.py
solution.code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
a = rng.normal(size=(1000, 256))
for _ in range(10):
    W = rng.normal(0, np.sqrt(2 / 256), (256, 256))
    a = np.maximum(0, a @ W)
print(bool(0.5 < a.std() < 3))

solution.name: main.py
solution.code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
a = rng.normal(size=(1000, 256))
for _ in range(10):
    a = np.tanh(a @ rng.normal(0, 0.01, (256, 256)))
print(bool(a.std() < 1e-6))
